_readme: Student side projects — things you built outside coursework. Course work belongs in the repository index instead. Add yourself with a pull request: one entry, own repo, public. Valid colors: navy, sea, teal, moss, amber, sun, rust, plum. Stars, language and the owner avatar are read live from GitHub, so do not put them here.

projects.title: tam
projects.blurb: Native macOS manager for terminal aliases — edit ~/.zshrc without opening it.

projects.title: RLeon
projects.blurb: Local-first macOS app doing on-device speech recognition and Vision OCR. Nothing leaves the machine.

projects.title: plexcode
projects.blurb: Local API proxy that routes CLI coding assistants through the provider you choose.

projects.title: callscoot
projects.blurb: Turns a Linux laptop into a Bluetooth call deck for an Android phone.

projects.title: keyseed
projects.blurb: Cross-platform desktop app for encrypting secrets locally. Written in Rust.

projects.title: rpmdeck
projects.blurb: Terminal music player with a spinning ASCII vinyl record.

projects.title: attentube
projects.blurb: Distraction-free YouTube viewer — search and watch, nothing else on the page.

projects.title: gitdex
projects.blurb: Makes a whole repository understandable to a language model in one pass.
